# Screenshot manifest for FEATURES.md - one line per image the document
# references: "image-path | config-panel-path-or-MANUAL | what it shows".
#
# AUTO rows are regenerated by a maintainer-side script
# via "kitty.exe -cfgpanel <panel> -demo-config-box <file>" - the automation
# owns FRESHNESS; which panels are shown, and every MANUAL shot, stays curated
# by hand. The same script drift-checks this list against FEATURES.md both
# ways: an image the document references must have a row here, and a row here
# must still be referenced.
#
# Panel paths are the config box's ctrl_settitle() paths; paths with spaces
# are fine (the runner quotes them). MANUAL = not a config panel (another
# window, another program, or a composed scene) - regenerated by hand.
# A row may carry a 4th field: extra kitty.ini lines for the render's clean
# room, ";"-separated, e.g. "ConfigBox:foldernavigation=yes" (section:line).
docs/features/img/session_list_classic.png | MANUAL                           | Session panel, folder dropdown, a session loaded (guest gate row shot_sessions_classic)
docs/features/img/session_list_rows.png    | MANUAL                           | Session panel, folders as rows (guest gate row shot_sessions_rows)
docs/features/img/manage_sessions.png      | MANUAL                           | Manage Sessions window (guest gate row shot_manage)

docs/features/img/config_password.jpg      | Connection/Login                 | auto-login password field
docs/features/img/config_autocommand.jpg   | Connection/Login                 | auto-command after login (same panel as the password - curation may prefer one image)
docs/features/img/config_forcecrlf.jpg     | Terminal/Keyboard                | Enter sends CR LF
docs/features/img/config_icon.jpg          | Window/Title                     | per-session icon chooser (the Title & Icon leaf)
docs/features/img/config_sendtotray.jpg    | Window/Behaviour                 | send-to-tray options
docs/features/img/config_transparency.jpg  | Window/Appearance/Background     | transparency options (the Background leaf)
docs/features/img/config_winscp_integration.jpg | Connection/SSH/WinSCP          | WinSCP integration panel (KSCP has its own panel now)
docs/features/img/config_zmodem.jpg        | Connection/ZModem                | ZModem transfer options
docs/features/img/config_proxychoice.jpg   | Session                          | named-proxy choice droplist (Proxy override options, on the Session panel)

docs/features/img/ex_protected.png         | MANUAL                           | A protected terminal: (PROTECTED) in its title (guest gate row shot_scene_protected)
